doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

chapter: Photo session: wagons, parades and goodbyes
title: Wrapping up: best cornet players and copying pictures
summary: As time runs out Laine says La Rocca was not among his best cornetists, names Brunies, and Russell asks to copy the photos.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Hey, you. You slack bucket.
I forgot. I forgot.
I forgot. I forgot. I forgot. I forgot. I forgot. I'm not this far here, you.
Listen, we must play very much with me. It's getting almost six o'clock, so I think we'd better...

He played a many job. He played a many job with me. But he didn't play very much with me. I didn't want to record. Because I had plenty of cornets players. Oh, that's all right. Oh, I had lots of cornets players.
Oh, this junk car. He was never regarded as one of the best.
Huh? I'm trash. He wasn't one of the best. No? Oh, no. No, no. The best I had was playing cornets, I'll tell you right now.
This time I'm gone, I don't know who's going to do it. I guess all that will get...
Ricky Brunish.
I guess so.
We moved all of my mother's pictures and things like that.
Yeah. Trying to sort of figure out who was what. Yeah. Why?
I'm thinking about the best.

My granddaughter. My daughter's daughter. She's got a... Oh, she's got books and all of my... But it's Dichman. She keeps a whole lot of my daughter. Charlie Dichman. She's got that book that they gave her.
He was another great company. Four guineas or five guineas?
And she's got a couple of magazines. They mastered a horn, brother. And she has a record, too.
You take this fella, Ricky Brunish, without any trouble at all, reach high sea like nobody's business. She's got all that trash.
Woo! She wouldn't have all that...
Ricky Brunish. The guy's living today.
She wouldn't give her that. No. Uh-uh. She runs him right now. He runs him right now.
He can't hardly walk her so old now. You think she runs in lane?

He's got to take his shoes off before he goes in the house. Yeah. Some day we'd like to get some copies of those pictures. I see you like Joe Buddy did. Maybe we can make a new copy of some of those pictures by photographing them again. And the band.
Anytime.
